title: Average without the truncation trap
prompt: `average(int a, int b)` must return the mean as a `double`. Beware: `(a + b) / 2` with two ints truncates BEFORE the assignment. `average(1, 2)` must be `1.5`, not `1.0`.

tests.name: fractional averages
tests.hint: Widen one operand before dividing: `(a + b) / 2.0`.

tests.name: negatives too
tests.hint: Same fix works; check the sign survives.
